Document ID: RM-DOC-0301
Headline: Corvenia suspends grain exports
Publisher: Runemark Maritime Council
Date: 2025-02-10
Doc Type: official_notice
Event_ID: EVT-C
Countries: Corvenia
Sectors: grain
Reliability: 1

Corvenia has suspended exports of milling grain from 2025-02-10 for sixty days to protect domestic supply.
